original_request: أنا عايزك تحدث بقى ملف الإندكس وترفع التحديثات على الفرع الرئيسي في الريبو.
goal: Publish the verified trust-launch improvements on the repository main branch with an updated bilingual homepage that exposes the golden workflow, measured offline performance and honest evidence boundaries.
target: index.html and the already verified trust-launch working-tree changes in the GIS-Development-Skills repository; publish only to origin/main.
desired_outcomes: The homepage presents the golden QGIS-oriented workflow and release-candidate proof in English and Arabic
All repository, website, security and release-gate checks pass after the homepage change
One reviewed commit containing the trust-launch work is pushed to origin/main and independently read back
success_criteria: The new homepage section is responsive, bilingual, keyboard-link accessible and preserves the protected author panel
Required validators, security audit and full unit suite pass on the exact pre-push working tree
The pushed origin/main commit matches the local HEAD and contains the intended files
constraints: Preserve the approved brand, exact English mission sentence, author panel markup and contact links
Do not claim native QGIS T2-T4, agent-client installation or external scanner execution
Do not rewrite history, force-push, create a tag or GitHub Release, or mutate repository administrator settings
Fetch and stop on any remote divergence instead of overwriting other contributors
non_goals: Running QGIS native acceptance in this revision
Changing GitHub About, topics, Discussions or Pages settings

tasks.title: Expose the golden workflow and proof on the homepage
tasks.description: Add a bilingual, responsive and accessible homepage section for the golden coordinate audit, bounded performance sample, evidence tiers and release-candidate links without changing protected author content.
acceptance_criteria: index.html contains one bilingual golden-workflow section with copyable offline command, measured T1 performance and explicit QGIS T2-T4 NOT RUN status
The homepage remains valid under existing navigation, bilingual, accessibility and JavaScript regression tests
The protected #author panel markup and existing catalog/language controls remain present

tasks.title: Verify, commit and publish the approved revision to main
tasks.description: Run mandatory release checks, review the exact diff, create one non-rewriting commit, fetch for divergence safety, push to origin/main and read back the remote commit.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog, API, skill-pack, manifest, skill-graph, security, website and full unit-test checks pass on the final files
The commit contains only the reviewed trust-launch and homepage files and is created without history rewriting
origin/main is pushed successfully and its commit ID equals local HEAD after remote readback
